description: Record the operator's decision on a reviewed invoice: approve or reject. Approving re-runs the hard rules in code (duplicate, vendor mismatch, missing PO over the limit, closed PO, over tolerance, line sum) and refuses when any fails; it then adds the total to the purchase order's billed-to-date. Fired only from the operator-confirmed Approve / Reject action via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools, so the model cannot call it.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to decide, e.g. inv_brightline_0417.

note.description: Optional operator note recorded with the decision.
